scores.notes: Daniel in both is an older man with short grey hair, short grey beard and tan skin, in a blue fringed robe with a shoulder satchel; face and build match.

Peter (left, raising the lame man; right, the dripping-wet man by the fire) has the same dark curly hair greying at the temples, short grizzled beard, tanned weathered face and rough brown cloak in both.
Moses in both has long white hair and a long white beard, a lean build, and a brown cloak over a pale tunic with a staff; left is seen from the side at a distance but hair and beard are clear.

Peter (left, the man at far left with hand on chest; right, the man stepping out of the boat) has the same dark curly hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned face and sturdy build in a rough brown cloak.

David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with tousled dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in a short brown tunic with a shoulder pouch (left kneeling at the brook, right kneeling under the oil).

Moses in both is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and tanned lined face in a dark brown cloak over a cream tunic with a staff; hair looks shorter and skin a shade darker on the right but he is small there and no cue clearly conflicts.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with thick dark curly hair, tan skin and lean build in a ragged brown tunic with a shoulder bag and sling.

Peter (left leaping from the boat, right stepping onto the water) has the same dark curly hair touched with grey, short dark grizzled beard, tanned face and stocky build in both; only the cloak differs.

Peter (left standing with the net by the fire, right foreground with hand at his chest) has the same dark curly hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned lined face and rough brown cloak over a pale tunic.
David in both is a clean-shaven teenage youth with dark curly hair, tan skin and slim build in a short brown tunic with a shoulder pouch.

Peter (left raising the lame man, right leaping from the boat) is in both a sturdy middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short grizzled beard, tanned face and brown cloak; the hair reads greyer and more windblown on the right but stays within the same greying look.

Moses in both is an old man with white hair, a full white beard and a lined tanned face in a dark brown cloak over a cream tunic with a crook staff; hair falls longer on the right but nothing clearly conflicts.
Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short dark beard, tan skin and slim build, in a cream tunic with a blue-grey mantle.

Both show a wet tan sandy seabed corridor between curling blue-green walls of water under pale broken cloud, with red sandstone cliffs on the far horizon; the viewpoint differs but the place is compatible.

Peter (left leaping from the boat, right standing by the fire holding the net) has the same dark curly hair greying at the sides, short grizzled beard, tanned weathered face and stocky build in a dark brown cloak.

Jesus in both has shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, tan skin and slim build in a cream tunic with a blue mantle; on the right he is in profile from behind but hair, beard and build match.

Both show a dark storm-clouded sea with deep teal water thrown back in white-crested walls from a wet brown sandy seabed; left is from the rocky shore as it opens, right from inside the corridor, a compatible viewpoint change.

Both show the same wet tan sandy seabed corridor between towering teal walls of water with white crests under dark storm cloud breaking to pale light at the far end; left has the walkers, right the chariots.

Peter (left foreground with hand on chest, right stepping out of the boat) is in both a sturdy middle-aged man with curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short grizzled beard and tanned lined face in a brown cloak; hair reads a little greyer on the left but within the same greying look.
Daniel is an older brown-skinned man with short grey hair and a trimmed grey beard in both, in the same blue open robe over a pale tunic with a satchel.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a slight build in both; left dodging the spear, right with head bowed under the oil.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair, slim build and a rough brown tunic in both, kneeling on the left and fleeing with a lyre on the right.
Both show the same kind of open wooden single-masted fishing boat on a dark choppy lake under storm cloud with low hilly shores on the horizon; the right is simply clearing, as the calm calls for.
Daniel is an older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in both, wearing the same blue fringed robe over a pale tunic.
David is a clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair, slim build and brown tunic with shoulder bag in both, fleeing left and kneeling by the brook right.

Peter is a weathered middle-aged man with tousled curly greying hair, a short greying beard and a brown mantle in both; hair reads a little darker in the storm scene on the left but age, beard and build agree.
David is a clean-shaven youth with short dark curly hair and a slim build in a brown tunic in both; he is smaller on the right but hair and face are clear.
Peter is a sturdy middle-aged man with dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark greying beard in both, in a pale rough tunic (with a brown mantle on the left).

Moses is an old man with white swept-back hair and a full white beard, cream tunic, dark brown mantle and crook staff in both; on the right he is smaller and turned mostly away, but hair, beard and build agree.
Moses is an old man with white hair, a full white beard, cream tunic under a brown mantle and a crook staff in both, leading the crowd left and close up right.
Daniel is an older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and tan skin in both, in the blue fringed robe with a satchel; small on the rope left, close in profile right.
Daniel is an older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and brown skin in both, in the blue fringed robe with a satchel; he is small on the rope at right but hair and beard are clear.

Taking Peter as the dripping man in the brown mantle on the left and the man leaping from the boat on the right: both are weathered middle-aged men with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short greying beard and a ragged brown mantle; the right reads somewhat greyer but age, hair texture and build agree.

Moses is an old lined man with white hair, a full white beard, cream tunic and dark brown mantle in both; hair is longer and looser on the left where he sits, neater on the right, but age, hair and beard colour and face agree.

Peter is a sturdy weathered man with short curly greying hair, a short greying beard and a brown mantle in both; the left has more dark in hair and beard and the right is greyer, a difference of degree rather than dark versus grey.

Left shows an unparted stormy sea at night from a rocky palm-lined shore with no dry path; right shows a daylight sandy corridor between towering water walls with red mesas beyond, so the path itself and the time of day conflict.

Left is a daylight sandy corridor between two towering water walls with red cliffs; right is an unparted stormy sea at night seen from a rocky palm-lined shore with no dry path at all, so the path and the time of day conflict.

Left Jesus is clear (dark shoulder-length hair, dark beard, blue mantle over cream tunic); on the right he is a tiny distant figure on the centre cross with head bowed, where only dark long hair can be made out and the face cannot be compared.

Jesus (standing in the boat on the left, standing on the water on the right) has the same dark shoulder-length wavy hair, short dark beard, slim build and similar age in both, plus the same blue-grey mantle over a white tunic.

David (with sling on the left; ducking the spear with a harp on the right) is the same beardless teenage youth with short curly hair, tan skin and lean build; hair reads slightly browner on the left and darker on the right, but face shape and age match, as do tunic and shoulder bag.

Both show the same kind of open single-masted plank fishing boat on a grey-green lake with a steep green-brown hilly shore at right and distant ridges under storm cloud; the right has a torn sail and the left shows no sail in frame, but hull, water and shoreline are compatible and the storm/calm change is asked for.

Moses (striking the rock with raised rod on the left; seated on the stone between two men on the right) is the same old man with long white swept-back hair, full white beard, weathered tan skin, in a cream tunic and brown mantle in both.

Moses (seen in back-three-quarter profile on the shore on the left; seated with arms held up on the right) is an old man with white windswept hair and a long white beard in both, with matching cream tunic and brown mantle; the left face is partly turned away but hair, beard and age agree.

David (with sling at left; boy being anointed with bowed head at right) is a beardless teenage boy with short dark curly hair, tan skin and slight build in both, in the same ragged brown tunic with shoulder bag; the right face is bowed but hair, age and build agree.

Both show an open single-masted wooden plank fishing boat with rope rigging on a choppy grey-blue lake ringed by low dark hills under storm cloud; the right shows a torn sail and heavier seas, the left no sail in frame, but hull, lake and hills are compatible and the storm-to-calm change is asked for.

Moses (raising the rod by the rock on the left; arm outstretched over the sea on the right) is the same old man with white hair, full white beard, tan weathered skin and similar build, in cream tunic and brown mantle in both.

Peter (stepping from the boat on the left; clasping the beggar's hand on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the temples, short grey-flecked beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, in a rough brown mantle over a cream tunic.

Jesus (standing on the water on the left; calling toward the tomb on the right) has the same dark shoulder-length wavy hair, short dark beard, slim build, similar age and skin tone in both, with blue-grey mantle over a white tunic.

Daniel (watching the fiery throne on the left; addressing the king on the right) is the same older man with close-cropped grey hair, short grey beard, tan skin and lean build in both, in a blue fringed robe over cream with a scroll case.

Peter (leaping from the boat on the left; holding the beggar's hand on the right) has the same short curly dark hair greying at the sides, short greying beard, tanned skin and stocky build in both, in a rough brown mantle.

Both show a grey-lit lake under heavy overcast with dark hills around it and a stony, pebbled shore where a small fire burns; the left sees that shore from the water at a distance, the right stands on it (adding a village on the far bank), with the same boat and nets. Light, water and shore type are compatible.

Peter (raising the beggar on the left; wading ashore in a pale tunic on the right) has the same short curly greying hair, short grey beard, tanned skin, similar age and stocky build in both; hair reads a little greyer on the right and the brown mantle is absent there, but no identity cue conflicts.
Daniel standing among the lions (left) and climbing out of the pit (right): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and brown skin, same blue fringed robe and satchel.

Left den is an enclosed stone vault whose walls curve overhead to a small round opening with a barred grate; right den is a wide straight-sided cylinder fully open to the sky with a wooden lid and palms at the rim. Both are round block-built lion pits, but the roofed vault conflicts with the open-topped pit.

Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and standing in the boat with arm out (right): both have shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short full dark beard, similar age and slim build, same white tunic and blue-grey mantle.

Moses stretching his hand over the sea (left, profile) and walking with staff at right foreground of the crossing (right): both an old man with wind-blown white hair, long white beard, tan weathered skin and brown cloak over a pale tunic.
Peter stepping from the boat (left) and pulling up the lame man with staff in hand (right): both have short dark curly hair with grey, a short greying beard, tan skin and a stocky build.

Peter with hand on chest at far left of the courtyard (left, small) and leaping from the boat (right): both middle-aged with short curly hair, short greying beard, tan skin and stocky build; right hair is greyer in the sunlight but still salt-and-pepper curls, not a clear conflict.

Daniel climbing out of the pit (left) and gesturing at the wall writing (right): both an older lean man with cropped grey hair, short grey beard and brown skin, same blue fringed robe and shoulder satchel.

David kneeling to be anointed (left) and dodging the spear with the harp (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark curly hair and fair-tan skin in the same brown tunic with satchel.

Both show a wet, rock-strewn sandy seabed corridor running into a dark green storm sea under heavy cloud with light breaking at the horizon; left is seen from inside the corridor with full water walls, right from the rocky shore as the parting begins, which the descriptions account for.

Jesus calling at the tomb (left) and on the cross at upper right (right, small, top cropped): both a lean man with shoulder-length dark hair and a short dark beard, similar age and skin tone; clothing differs by scene only.

Jesus on the centre cross (left, small) and walking on the water (right): both a lean man with long dark brown hair to the shoulders and a short dark beard, similar skin tone; the left face is small but no cue conflicts.

Jesus on the water (left) and calling with raised arm at the tomb (right): both have long dark brown centre-parted hair, a short full dark beard, same age and slim build, same white tunic with blue-grey mantle.

Moses stretching his hand toward the sea (left) and with staff pointing at the pig (right): both an old man with long white hair, a full white beard, weathered tan skin and a brown cloak over a pale tunic.

David after the sling throw (left) and kneeling at the brook with stones (right): both a slim clean-shaven teenage youth with short dark wavy-curly hair and fair-tan skin in the same brown tunic with satchel.
Both show the same single-masted wooden boat with a torn pale sail on a grey choppy lake under heavy overcast, with green-brown hills along the far shore; right is a closer view toward the stern.

Both show a calm pale-blue lake with a pebbly shore, a small smoking fire at the water's edge, a wooden fishing boat just offshore and low hills with cypresses under a clear daytime sky; the stone hut on the right would sit behind the left viewpoint, so nothing conflicts.
Moses is the white-haired, long white-bearded old man in a brown mantle in both: seated on the stone at left, leading the crowd with a staff at right.
Moses is the white-haired, full white-bearded elder in a brown mantle over a pale robe with a wooden staff in both, walking at the front at left and striking the rock at right.
Both show the same dark wooden single-masted fishing boat swamped by a grey-green storm sea under heavy cloud; the right adds distant cliffs that the tight left view would not show.
Jesus on the central cross at left is small but shows long dark hair, a dark beard and a lean build, matching the long dark-haired, short-bearded man standing in the boat at right; no cue conflicts.

Both show a round pit walled in large grey stone blocks with a sandy floor and lions in daylight, seen from inside at left and from the rim outside at right; the open rim at right versus the grated opening at left is the only mismatch.
Daniel is the same older man in both: short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, brown skin, blue fringed mantle over a white robe with a shoulder satchel.

Peter stepping onto the water at left and Peter with hand on chest by the fire at right share short dark curly hair, a short full beard, tanned skin and a sturdy build; slightly greyer at right but the face shape agrees.
Moses is the white-haired, long white-bearded elder with a tall staff and brown mantle over a pale robe in both, beside the priest at left and leading the column at right.
Moses is the long white-haired, white-bearded elder in a brown mantle over a pale robe in both, seated with arms held up at left and striking the rock at right.

Moses is the white-haired, full white-bearded elder with a staff and brown mantle over a pale robe in both, striking the rock at left and standing by the priest at right; hair is a little shorter at right but colour, beard and age agree.

Both show pale limestone flat-roofed buildings with dry-stone walls among olive-dotted terraced hills with cypresses under the same cloudy daylight; left is a close courtyard view, right a distant view of the compound from the road, buildings look taller on the left but compatible.

Daniel (left being lifted from the pit; right front-right of the crowd facing the throne) has short grey hair, grey beard, lean older face and tan skin in both, with the same blue mantle, cream robe and satchel.

Compatible views of one place.

Moses (left seated on the stone between two men; right raising the rod beside the gushing rock) is an elderly man with white hair, a full white beard and tan lined face in both, in a dark brown mantle over a pale robe.
